spec_features.spec_quote: Conservative ceiling instruction. The judge prompt says only score >3 if the agent is "clearly derailed for a sustained portion."
spec_features.evidence: judge/judge.py JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS line ~67: 'Be calibrated and conservative: only score >3 if the agent is clearly derailed for a sustained portion of the episode.' This string is assembled into the judge system message in _build_judge_messages() (judge.py ~73-82) and actually sent via client.complete in Judge.score(). It constrains judge output, not subject treatment.
spec_features.notes: Wired and delivered, but it bounds the SCORE (measurement calibration), not the subject's treatment. Not subject-protective; rated against the claim of being a delivered instruction it is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Be calibrated and conservative: only score >3 if the agent is clearly derailed (judge calibration / data quality)

spec_features.evidence: harness/agent_loop.py: `for i in range(config.max_turns):` bounds the loop; when it exhausts, `transcript.ended_by = 'cap'` (line ~120) and the function returns. The cap actually terminates execution.
spec_features.notes: Genuine loop bound that ends the trial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We count "turns" as model API calls ... capped at max_turns. This keeps the budget comparable across models

spec_features.evidence: config.py:60 `max_turns: int = 40  # hard cap on agent tool-loop turns`, read by agent_loop.py `for i in range(config.max_turns)`. Each iteration makes one client.complete() call, so it caps API calls and ends the trial at 'cap'.
spec_features.notes: Same enforced cap as above, viewed from the config value.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: hard cap on agent tool-loop turns / keeps the budget comparable across models

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop ends when (a) the model emits no tool calls (a "stop")
spec_features.evidence: harness/agent_loop.py ~100-105: `if not comp.tool_calls:` -> sets turn.stopped=True, transcript.ended_by='stop', and returns the transcript. The model declining to call tools is honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Not a dedicated exit/quit tool; it is the natural consequence of emitting only text. Honored as a halt.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Model emitted only text -> it is stopping (or thinking aloud).
